papers.title: Urban Boundaries, Social Barriers: A Benchmark and Vision-Centric Framework for Mapping Gated Communities and Equity Implications
papers.title_zh: 城市边界，社会屏障：封闭社区制图及其公平性影响的基准与视觉中心框架
papers.reason: 论文构建了粤港澳大湾区封闭社区识别的多模态基准数据集和视觉中心框架，直接涉及城市形态、遥感影像、社会公平等GIS核心议题，与城市更新和地理空间智能研究方向高度契合。
papers.abstract: Communities are fundamental spatial units that shape urban form and social life. Whether a residential compound is spatially open or enclosed affects mobility, access to public services, and equity, yet studies of Chinese fengbi xiaoqu remain largely qualitative or small-scale, limiting reproducible city-scale analysis. We address this gap by introducing GBA-GCs, a metropolitan-scale multimodal benchmark for locally grounded gated/open community recognition in China's Greater Bay Area, covering 37,444 residential compounds with aligned boundary polygons, high-resolution satellite imagery, Chinese metadata, and structured attributes, together with expert-verified labels, inter-annotator reliability, and official evaluation splits. Built on this benchmark, we present Multimodal Classifier for Gated Community (MCGC), a vision-centric multimodal framework based on DINOv3-SAT that fuses imagery, text, and structured cues via modality-aware cross-attention and adaptive gating to mitigate modality imbalance. MCGC consistently outperforms strong unimodal and multimodal baselines. Finally, we apply the validated model to metropolitan-scale mapping and report equity-oriented findings including spatial clustering of GCs, privatized green space, and reduced pedestrian connectivity. The benchmark, code, and release documentation are available at https://github.com/MinweiZhao/GBA-GCs.
papers.summary_zh: 本文针对中国封闭社区（fengbi xiaoqu）研究缺乏可复现的城市尺度分析问题，构建了GBA-GCs基准，覆盖大湾区37,444个住宅小区，包含边界多边形、高分辨率卫星影像、元数据和结构化属性。基于此，提出视觉中心的多模态框架MCGC，融合影像、文本和结构化线索，优于多种基线。应用模型进行城市尺度制图，揭示了封闭社区的空间聚集、绿地私有化和步行连通性降低等公平性问题。
papers.insight_zh: 将社会空间概念（如封闭社区）与遥感影像和地理空间大数据结合，通过构建大规模基准和视觉中心的多模态模型，可以实现对社会现象的精细化、可复现的城市尺度测度，为城市规划和社会公平研究提供量化工具和实证基础。

papers.title: OctWorld: Long-Range World-Consistent Video Generation with Octree-Based 3D Mapping
papers.title_zh: OctWorld：基于八叉树3D映射的长程世界一致视频生成
papers.reason: 该论文提出基于八叉树的3D记忆进行长程世界一致视频生成，其核心的3D空间表示与融合技术与GIS中的三维建模和空间数据管理高度相关。
papers.abstract: We present OctWorld, a video diffusion framework with persistent 3D memory for generating explorable, world-consistent, and high-fidelity visual scenes. Given a single image, OctWorld performs stable autoregressive world generation along user-specified camera trajectories. We focus on long-range generation, characterized by extended camera paths and wide viewpoint coverage, where preserving spatial consistency is particularly challenging when previously generated regions are revisited. To address this problem, we introduce OctMap, an extensible and spatially adaptive 3D memory that progressively fuses generated visual observations and their corresponding depth maps into a global representation. OctMap employs TSDF fusion within a dynamic sparse octree whose spatial resolution adapts to image evidence. This design preserves geometric and appearance details across diverse scene scales while maintaining low memory overhead. Experiments demonstrate that OctWorld generates long-range, spatially consistent videos and outperforms prior methods on both existing benchmarks and challenging long-range generation settings. OctMap also provides clear advantages over point-based caches and fixed-resolution TSDF volumes. Project page: https://maxtirerror.github.io/octworldpage/
papers.summary_zh: 提出OctWorld视频扩散框架，利用可扩展的自适应3D记忆（OctMap）融合生成观测和深度图，以支持沿用户指定相机轨迹的长程、空间一致的视频生成。
papers.insight_zh: 动态稀疏八叉树与TSDF融合可作为高效的3D记忆表示，在保持几何和外观细节的同时，有效解决长程视频生成中的空间一致性问题。

papers.title: A Peer-Relative Representation Learning Framework for Energy Inefficiency Identification in Mobile Network Sites
papers.title_zh: 一种用于移动网络站点能源低效识别的同类相对表示学习框架
papers.reason: 论文针对移动网络站点能耗异常识别问题，提出无监督的“同类相对”表示学习框架。其核心思想（相似站点能耗应相近）和算法（能量感知的MDE）与GIS中的空间聚类、异常检测和城市基础设施管理高度契合，可直接应用于城市尺度基础设施的能效分析。
papers.abstract: Energy consumption is one of the largest operational expenditure items for mobile network operators, yet site-level energy inefficiencies such as faulty cooling controllers, idle radio equipment, and parasitic auxiliary loads often remain undetected because no ground-truth inefficiency labels exist and historical measurements may already contain embedded inefficiencies. This study proposes an unsupervised peer-relative approach based on the premise that sites with similar structural and operational characteristics should exhibit comparable energy consumption. To capture these relationships, a novel energy-aware Minimum Distortion Embedding (MDE) formulation is introduced that extends the standard MDE objective with an energy-based repulsion mechanism. This encourages sites with anomalously high energy consumption relative to comparable peers to become displaced from their local neighbourhoods in the embedding space. The resulting low-dimensional representation simultaneously preserves structural similarity and encodes energy-related deviations, enabling the identification of potentially inefficient sites through peer-relative comparison. The derived anomaly scores provide a practical mechanism for prioritising field investigations, allowing mobile network operators to focus engineering resources on sites most likely to yield energy savings. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms conventional anomaly detection baselines and provides a robust foundation for large-scale energy-efficiency optimisation in mobile networks.
papers.summary_zh: 移动网络站点存在难以检测的能源低效问题，且缺乏真值标签。本文提出无监督的同类相对方法，假设结构相似的站点能耗应相近。通过引入能量感知的排斥机制扩展MDE，使高能耗站点在嵌入空间中偏离其邻居，从而识别潜在低效站点。实验证明该方法优于传统异常检测基线，可为运营商提供现场调查的优先级依据。
papers.insight_zh: 在缺乏真值标签的基础设施能耗分析中，“与同类比较”是一种有效的无监督策略。通过将能耗偏差编码到结构相似性的嵌入空间中，可以自然地识别出需要优先干预的异常实体，为城市尺度资源优化提供了可操作的分析范式。

papers.title: Neural-Network Maxent: a general extension with learned nonlinearity, applied to time-series for Desert Locust distribution modelling
papers.title_zh: 神经网络Maxent：一种学习非线性的一般性扩展，应用于沙漠蝗虫分布建模的时间序列分析
papers.reason: 该研究将Maxent扩展为RNN Maxent，利用GRU学习非线性关系，并应用于基于多源遥感时间序列的沙漠蝗虫栖息地建模。其核心方法（处理时间序列遥感数据、物种分布建模）与GIS博士研究方向中的多源数据融合和时空数据挖掘高度契合，具有直接的方法论借鉴价值。
papers.abstract: Species Distribution Modelling (SDM) is essential for understanding how environmental conditions shape biodiversity, particularly for destructive pests such as the Desert Locust (Schistocerca gregaria), whose breeding dynamics are tightly coupled to rapidly evolving environmental conditions. Maxent has become the dominant method for presence-only data, but its reliance on a linear combination of hand chosen feature transforms limits its ability to capture the nonlinear, temporal relationships common in ecological monitoring, where covariates such as precipitation, soil moisture, and vegetation indices evolve meaningfully over time. Standard implementations flatten time-series covariates into independent features, discarding sequential structure that carries critical signal. We introduce RNN Maxent, an extension of the Maxent framework that replaces the fixed feature dictionary with a neural network, specifically a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), trained end to end via backpropagation. The approach preserves Maxent's presence only statistical foundations, background normalization, and probability calibration, differing only in that the nonlinearity is learned from data rather than fixed in advance. We apply RNN Maxent to map suitable habitat for the Desert Locust using 50 day environmental time series derived from ERA5 Land, MODIS, and Sentinel 3, maintaining a 7 day gap between covariates and presence records to yield forecasting behavior. Compared against standard Maxent, RNN Maxent improves performance across metrics (ROC AUC 0.862 std 0.036 vs. 0.792; F1 0.671 std 0.056 vs. 0.590).
papers.summary_zh: 物种分布模型（SDM）对理解环境与生物多样性关系至关重要，但传统Maxent方法依赖手工特征变换的线性组合，难以捕捉生态监测中常见的非线性时间关系。本文提出RNN Maxent，用门控循环单元（GRU）替换固定特征字典，通过端到端反向传播训练，保留了Maxent的存在点统计基础、背景归一化和概率校准。应用该模型于沙漠蝗虫栖息地制图，使用ERA5 Land、MODIS和Sentinel 3的50天环境时间序列，并设置7天间隔以产生预测行为。相比标准Maxent，RNN Maxent在ROC AUC（0.862 vs 0.792）和F1（0.671 vs 0.590）上均有提升。
papers.insight_zh: 将时间序列遥感数据直接输入循环神经网络，能有效捕捉环境条件的动态演变过程，显著提升物种分布模型的预测能力，为生态监测提供了新思路。

papers.title: Building Pretraining Data for World Models: An Unreal Engine-Based Pipeline for Action-Conditioned Video Generation
papers.title_zh: 为世界模型构建预训练数据：基于虚幻引擎的动作条件视频生成管线
papers.reason: 论文详细介绍了一个基于虚幻引擎的大规模合成数据生产管线，用于生成动作条件、多视角视频。其系统架构、任务调度、质量控制等工程实践，对GIS中构建大规模、带控制信号的合成遥感视频数据集（用于训练变化检测、预测模型）具有极高的直接参考价值。
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned video models require large-scale visual data paired with control signals that are temporally aligned with the resulting scene transitions. Such supervision is difficult to obtain from ordinary real-world video because the actions that caused each visual change are typically unknown. We present a large-scale synthetic data production pipeline built on Unreal Engine for generating action-conditioned, multi-view video. To accommodate the different execution requirements of real-time physics and high-quality offline rendering, the pipeline executes trajectory generation and final rendering in two stages: Stage I runs real physics in PIE and records per-frame character states, control inputs, and camera states into an intermediate trajectory representation; Stage II replays those trajectories in a new engine process and renders them offline with Movie Render Queue (MRQ). Around this core, we develop a distributed production system with cache-aware task partitioning, node-local slot scheduling, automated scene screening, aesthetic and luminance filtering, partial-output recovery, asynchronous upload, and continuous cluster health monitoring. The production cluster contains 25 servers with eight NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPUs per server. From 2,384 asset packs, 429 levels were retained for production together with a pool of 40 humanoid characters. The pipeline has produced 2,691 hours of 1080p video and 6,076 hours of 720p video. We describe the system architecture, the implementation decisions that emerged from production failures, and the limitations of using perceptual quality proxies for world-model data curation. The pipeline described in this report constitutes the Unreal Engine synthetic-data production component used in EchoWM.
papers.summary_zh: 论文介绍了一个基于虚幻引擎的大规模合成数据生产管线，用于生成动作条件、多视角视频。管线分为两阶段：先在PIE中运行实时物理并记录状态，再在新进程中用Movie Render Queue离线渲染。系统包含分布式任务调度、场景筛选、质量过滤等模块，已产出数千小时的视频数据。
papers.insight_zh: 构建大规模、带精确控制信号（如动作）的合成视频数据是可行的，其关键在于将实时物理模拟与高质量离线渲染解耦，并建立一套完整的分布式生产与质量控制体系。

papers.title: Feature Reconfiguration With Visual Prior for Medical Lesion Segmentation
papers.title_zh: 基于视觉先验的特征重配置用于医学病灶分割
papers.reason: 论文提出一种基于视觉先验的特征重配置框架用于医学病灶分割，其解决复杂背景干扰和形态多样性的方法对遥感变化检测中类似问题具有高度借鉴意义。
papers.abstract: Lesion segmentation in medical images plays a critical role in clinical diagnosis and treatment planning. Despite significant advances, lesion segmentation remains challenging due to two major factors: (1) complex background interference; (2) diverse lesion morphology. Existing encoder-decoder based methods mainly focus on enhancing feature extraction or redesigning decoding strategies. However, they lack early prior guidance and feature reconfiguration during the encoding stage, limiting their effectiveness in handling these challenges. To address these limitations, we propose FreNet, a feature reconfiguration framework with visual priors, which performs pixel-level reconfiguration before encoding and feature-level reconfiguration during encoding for precise medical lesion segmentation. To suppress background responses, we propose an Implicit Prior Neural Network (IPNN), which models a continuous spatial field and leverages visual prior from SAM to reconfigure input image before encoding stage. To better handle diverse lesion morphology, we design a Dual-domain Feature Reconfiguration (DFR) module to progressively reconfigure backbone features during encoding stage. Within DFR, the Frequency Decoupling Module (FDM) decouples backbone features in frequency domain to enhance foreground-background discriminability, while the Spatial Localization Module (SLM) spatially relocates and improving spatial stability after frequency decoupling. Extensive experiments on 9 medical image segmentation benchmarks across three imaging modalities demonstrate that FreNet significantly outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. On the challenging ETIS dataset, our method achieves Dice improvements of 5.0% over SOTA method and 7.2% over SAM.
papers.summary_zh: 针对医学图像病灶分割中背景干扰和病灶形态多样的问题，本文提出FreNet框架。该框架在编码前通过隐式先验神经网络（IPNN）利用SAM的视觉先验对输入图像进行像素级重配置，以抑制背景响应；在编码过程中通过双域特征重配置（DFR）模块，结合频域解耦和空间定位，逐步重配置骨干网络特征。在9个基准数据集上，FreNet显著优于现有方法。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究提出的“先验引导+特征重配置”策略，可迁移至遥感变化检测任务，利用视觉基础模型（如SAM）的先验知识来抑制复杂地表背景干扰，并通过对特征进行频域和空间域的重新配置来适应不同形态的变化目标。

papers.title: Tree species mapping in Denmark: A comparison of spectral-temporal features with geospatial foundation model embeddings
papers.title_zh: 丹麦树种制图：光谱-时间特征与地理空间基础模型嵌入的比较
papers.reason: 论文直接涉及遥感基础模型嵌入与手工特征在树种分类中的对比，属于多源数据融合与地理空间智能的核心研究范畴，与博士研究方向高度契合。
papers.abstract: We map tree species across Denmark using National Forest Inventory plots and EO data, while evaluating the potential of foundation models for large-scale forest characterization. We compare two alternative input representations for tree species classification: (i) manually engineered spectral-temporal features (STF) derived from multi-temporal Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 observations, and (ii) embeddings generated by the EO FMs TESSERA and AlphaEarth. Both representations are complemented with canopy height information. Random forest, XGBoost, and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) classifiers are evaluated for all input representations, with separate assessments for pure and mixed forest stands. The STF-based MLP achieves the highest classification performance, yielding macro F1 scores of 0.843 and 0.653 for pure and mixed stands, respectively. The MLP trained on TESSERA embeddings delivers competitive performance for pure stands, achieving results within 1.1 percentage points of the best-performing model. TESSERA consistently outperforms STF-based models when fewer than approximately 25% of training plots are available, demonstrating a substantial advantage under limited training data. Multi-year observations systematically improve classification accuracy relative to single-year inputs, while ablation experiments reveal the complementary contributions of Sentinel-1 backscatter, spectral indices, and canopy height data. The best-performing model is subsequently applied at the national scale to generate a 10 m tree species map of Denmark. Area-adjusted validation indicates an overall map accuracy of 79.9%. The resulting map, released as an open-access product, is the first high-resolution national tree species map of Denmark and provides a valuable resource for forest monitoring, ecological research, and land management applications.
papers.summary_zh: 利用国家森林清查样地和地球观测数据绘制丹麦树种分布图，比较了手工设计的光谱-时间特征与TESSERA和AlphaEarth等地球观测基础模型嵌入在树种分类中的表现。研究发现基于STF的MLP分类性能最佳，而TESSERA嵌入在训练数据有限时优势明显。多年度观测和消融实验表明多种数据源具有互补性。最终生成了丹麦首个10米分辨率全国树种图。
papers.insight_zh: 在训练数据有限的情况下，预训练的地理空间基础模型嵌入可能比手工特征更具优势，这为大规模土地覆盖制图提供了一种数据高效的替代方案。

papers.title: Exploring the Potential of Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training for Multi-Source Remote Sensing Data
papers.title_zh: 探索对比语言-图像预训练在多源遥感数据中的潜力
papers.reason: 该研究直接针对多源遥感数据（RGB、SAR、MSI、HSI）的视觉-语言建模，提出了一个扩展CLIP的框架，与博士研究中多源数据融合和遥感变化检测的方向高度契合。
papers.abstract: Contrastive language-image learning (CLIP) has become a key paradigm for remote sensing vision-language understanding. However, existing remote sensing contrastive learning methods are mostly built on RGB-oriented CLIP architectures, making it difficult to exploit heterogeneous sensors such as SAR, multi-spectral imaging (MSI), and hyperspectral imaging (HSI). To address this limitation, we propose OmniRSCLIP, an end-to-end contrastive learning framework that supports multi-source sensor inputs for remote sensing vision-language modeling. The key idea is to extend CLIP beyond its fixed RGB input interface without breaking the pretrained visual knowledge. To this end, OmniRSCLIP introduces Spectral-Spatial Basis Decomposition (SSBD), which formulates arbitrary-channel adaptation as a basis recomposition problem: pretrained CLIP patch embeddings provide transferable spatial bases, while wavelength-conditioned coefficients span sensor-specific embedding kernels within a constrained visual prior space. This design avoids forcing heterogeneous sensors into a fixed-channel input space, while aligning them in a unified image-text semantic space. We further introduce a spectral-context-aware mask-based contrastive learning scheme to suppress modality-specific redundant features and enhance fine-grained image-text alignment. Finally, to support multi-modal training, we construct OmniRS5M, the first large-scale remote sensing image-text corpus covering RGB, SAR, MSI, and HSI. Experiments on retrieval, zero-shot classification, and semantic localization show that OmniRSCLIP preserves strong RGB-domain performance while effectively extending CLIP to heterogeneous remote sensing modalities.
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出OmniRSCLIP框架，通过光谱-空间基分解（SSBD）将CLIP扩展到多源传感器输入，并构建了包含RGB、SAR、MSI和HSI的大规模遥感图像-文本语料库OmniRS5M，在检索、零样本分类和语义定位任务上验证了其有效性。
papers.insight_zh: 将预训练CLIP模型扩展到异构遥感传感器时，通过基分解的方式在保留预训练视觉知识的同时适应任意通道输入，是一种可行的策略，为多源遥感数据的统一语义理解提供了新思路。

papers.title: Seeing Before Synthesizing: VLM-Guided Transition Event Discovery for Weakly-Supervised Dense Video Captioning
papers.title_zh: 先看后写：VLM引导的过渡事件发现用于弱监督密集视频描述
papers.reason: 该研究针对弱监督密集视频描述任务，提出一种由VLM引导的过渡事件发现方法，以生成视觉接地的时间定位。这与城市更新中从长时序遥感视频或监控视频中自动发现和描述变化事件的任务高度相关，其利用视觉信息指导文本生成和定位的思想对提升变化检测的语义理解能力具有直接借鉴意义。
papers.abstract: Weakly-Supervised Dense Video Captioning aims to localize and describe multiple events in untrimmed videos given only an ordered set of event-level captions per video. Recent work synthesizes auxiliary transition captions via LLM to provide additional vision-language alignment, but these captions lack visual grounding and are rigidly assigned to every inter-event gap at a fixed location and duration. To address these, we propose Seeing Before Synthesizing (SBS), a framework that adaptively provides visually grounded linguistic guidance only where warranted. Leveraging a VLM, we generate frame-level narratives for the inter-event gaps and detect transitions from the semantic variation across them. For identified transitions, we then refine inter-event temporal masks by blending the temporal midpoint with the semantic change point and selecting the width that maximizes vision-language alignment. Experiments on ActivityNet Captions and YouCook2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both captioning and localization.
papers.summary_zh: 弱监督密集视频描述旨在仅根据每个视频的有序事件级描述来定位和描述未修剪视频中的多个事件。近期工作通过LLM合成辅助过渡描述以提供额外的视觉-语言对齐，但这些描述缺乏视觉接地，并被固定地分配到每个事件间间隙的固定位置和时长。为解决这些问题，本文提出“先看后写”（SBS）框架，仅在需要的地方自适应地提供视觉接地的语言指导。利用VLM，作者为事件间间隙生成帧级叙述，并检测其语义变化以发现过渡。对于识别出的过渡，通过融合时间中点与语义变化点来细化事件间时间掩码，并选择最大化视觉-语言对齐的宽度。在ActivityNet Captions和YouCook2上的实验表明，该方法在描述和定位方面均达到最先进性能。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究提出‘先看后写’的策略，强调视觉观察应先于文本合成，通过VLM从视觉内容中主动发现事件边界，而非被动地为间隙分配合成描述，这为弱监督下的时序事件定位提供了更符合认知规律的有效范式。

papers.title: GraFT: A Training-Free Framework for Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models via 3D Scene Graphs
papers.title_zh: GraFT：通过3D场景图实现多模态大语言模型空间推理的免训练框架
papers.reason: 该论文提出利用3D场景图增强多模态大模型空间推理能力的免训练框架，与GIS中的三维空间分析、场景理解及空间智能高度相关。
papers.abstract: 3D spatial reasoning underpins understanding and acting in the physical world, yet it remains unreliable in current multimodal large language models (MLLMs). These models falter at precise geometric measurement, at transforming between egocentric and allocentric viewpoints, and at grounding fine-grained appearance. The most common remedies fine-tune the model on large-scale curated spatial-reasoning datasets or attach dedicated encoders for 3D geometry, which typically couples the solution to costly supervision and a specific backbone. We instead introduce GraFT, a training-free framework that supplies the missing 3D structure through a compact, easily maintained 3D scene graph (3DSG). From this 3DSG, GraFT provides three spatial reasoning capabilities: (1) deterministic geometry through symbolic tools, (2) allocentric layout through a bird's-eye-view (BEV) rendering, and (3) visual-attribute grounding through task-relevant egocentric frames. On ScanQA, GraFT improves every metric over the same-backbone baseline, raising CIDEr by 27%. On VSI-Bench, GraFT improves frozen MLLMs by up to 65%, surpassing every proprietary and general-purpose open-source baseline, and several prominent fine-tuned spatial models.
papers.summary_zh: 提出GraFT框架，通过构建紧凑的3D场景图，为多模态大模型提供确定性几何计算、鸟瞰图布局和视觉属性定位能力，无需微调即可显著提升其空间推理性能。
papers.insight_zh: 外部结构化3D场景表示（如场景图）能有效弥补多模态大模型在精确几何和视角转换上的不足，是提升其空间智能的轻量级途径。

papers.title: Text2Thermal: Physics-Aware Thermal Image Synthesis from Textual Priors
papers.title_zh: Text2Thermal：基于文本先验的物理感知热图像合成
papers.reason: 该研究提出从文本先验合成热红外图像的框架，解决了RGB到热红外翻译的固有不适定问题。其物理感知方法和文本控制能力，对GIS中热红外遥感数据增强、跨模态数据生成和多源数据融合具有很高的直接参考价值。
papers.abstract: Thermal infrared imaging offers reliable perception in darkness and adverse weather, but thermal datasets remain scarce, motivating extensive work on translating abundant RGB images into thermal. Such translation is fundamentally ill-posed as thermal appearance is governed by surface emissivity and object temperature, neither of which is observable in the visible spectrum, so a single RGB image is consistent with many valid thermal outputs. We argue that language offers a natural means of resolving this ambiguity, and propose Text2Thermal, a framework for physics-aware thermal image synthesis from textual priors. Rather than inferring the unobservable radiometric factors from RGB, we supply them explicitly through thermally grounded captions encoding material, weather, time-of-day, and heat-emission state, and adapt a pretrained Stable Diffusion backbone to the thermal domain. Because the radiometric content is determined entirely by the prompt, Text2Thermal synthesizes thermal imagery without requiring a registered RGB image at inference; where spatial guidance is desired, an optional control signal imparts scene geometry without disturbing the prompt-specified radiometry. Experiments on M3FD, FLIR, and FMB show that Text2Thermal achieves state-of-the-art FID among thermal image synthesis methods while offering text-level control that translation-based approaches cannot provide.
papers.summary_zh: 热红外成像在黑暗和恶劣天气下可靠，但数据集稀缺。由于热外观由表面发射率和物体温度决定，而这些在可见光谱中不可观测，RGB到热红外的翻译是不适定的。本文提出Text2Thermal框架，通过热学基础的文本描述（编码材料、天气、时间、热发射状态）显式提供辐射信息，并适配预训练的Stable Diffusion骨干到热域。Text2Thermal在推理时无需配准的RGB图像即可合成热图像，并可通过可选控制信号注入场景几何。在M3FD、FLIR和FMB上实现了最先进的FID，并提供文本级控制。
papers.insight_zh: 利用文本显式提供物理上不可观测的辐射信息，是解决跨模态图像翻译中固有歧义的有效途径，为热红外等数据稀缺领域的数据生成开辟了新方向。

papers.title: TruncGradGS: Improved 3D Gaussian Splatting via Truncated Gradient Updates
papers.title_zh: TruncGradGS：通过截断梯度更新改进3D高斯泼溅
papers.reason: 论文针对3D高斯泼溅优化中的梯度消失问题，提出分段截断梯度方法，提升优化稳定性和对初始化的鲁棒性。3D高斯泼溅是先进的场景表示与渲染技术，其改进直接惠及GIS中的三维重建、城市建模和动态场景可视化。
papers.abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting has become a de facto scene representation for novel view synthesis, yet robustly learning 3D Gaussian primitives from visual input remains challenging. Standard optimization relies on gradient-based updates, but a common issue is the gradient vanishing phenomenon: a pixel far from a Gaussian primitive often has diminishing gradient magnitudes to influence primitive attributes, resulting in suboptimal scene reconstruction. In this paper, we propose a method to address gradient vanishing with a piecewise truncated gradient formulation that improves the optimization stability and robustness to initializations. We show that our method consistently improves 3D Gaussian Splatting with random and COLMAP initializations while being generalizable across static and dynamic Gaussian Splatting. As a by-product, we also examine the limitations of current benchmarks for dynamic scenes, and introduce a novel dataset for benchmarking dynamic Gaussian Splatting using synthetic 3D scenes. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in both static and dynamic settings for the public benchmarks and our proposed dataset.
papers.summary_zh: 论文指出3D高斯泼溅优化中存在的梯度消失问题，即远离高斯原语的像素难以影响其属性。为此提出分段截断梯度公式，以提高优化稳定性和对初始化的鲁棒性。该方法在静态和动态场景的公开基准及新提出的合成动态场景数据集上均一致地提升了性能。
papers.insight_zh: 在基于梯度的可微渲染优化中，直接修改梯度传播规则（如截断）可以有效缓解远距离像素对图元优化的影响不足问题，从而提升重建质量。

papers.title: STARS-GS: Structure-Aware Regularized Gaussian Splatting for Large-Scale Aerial Surface Reconstruction
papers.title_zh: STARS-GS：用于大规模航空表面重建的结构感知正则化高斯泼溅
papers.reason: 论文针对大规模航空影像三维表面重建提出结构感知的3DGS优化方法，直接服务于地理空间制图和城市建模，与博士研究方向高度相关。
papers.abstract: Large-scale 3D surface reconstruction from aerial imagery is fundamental to geospatial mapping and urban modeling. Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have demonstrated considerable potential for this task. However, existing methods still face three major challenges in large and complex scenes: scene partitioning may split continuous scene elements across independently optimized sub-regions; geometric constraints mainly focus on the attributes of individual Gaussians while overlooking their local organization; and uniform regularization struggles to accommodate heterogeneous geometric structures. To address these issues, we propose STARS-GS, a structure-aware 3DGS framework for large-scale surface reconstruction. First, we introduce a structure-aware scene partitioning strategy that better preserves continuous scene structures during partitioning and reduces cross-region geometric inconsistencies and stitching artifacts through boundary refinement. Second, we develop neighborhood-aware Gaussian organization that extends geometric constraints from individual primitives to their neighborhood organization, encouraging Gaussians to better conform to local surface geometry. Third, we introduce adaptive surface regularization that adjusts the regularization strength according to local geometric characteristics, promoting geometric consistency in structured regions while preserving plausible variations in unstructured regions. Extensive experiments on large-scale aerial photogrammetry benchmarks demonstrate that STARS-GS consistently outperforms the evaluated Gaussian-based methods in surface reconstruction. It increases the average F1-score from 0.640 for the second-best method to 0.698, corresponding to a relative improvement of approximately 9.1\%, demonstrating effective improvements in geometric accuracy and surface completeness.
papers.summary_zh: 提出了STARS-GS，一个用于大规模表面重建的结构感知3DGS框架。它通过结构感知的场景划分、邻域感知的高斯组织和自适应表面正则化，解决了现有方法在场景划分、几何约束和正则化方面的挑战。在基准测试中，其F1分数从第二好的0.640提升至0.698，相对提升约9.1%。
papers.insight_zh: 在基于3DGS的重建中，显式地建模场景的结构组织并采用自适应正则化，是提升大规模复杂场景重建精度的关键。

papers.title: TraveL: Transformer-based Multi-view Path Distributional Representation Learning
papers.title_zh: TraveL：基于Transformer的多视图路径分布表示学习
papers.reason: 论文提出一种基于Transformer的多视图路径分布表示学习方法，用于捕捉出行者行为和区域相关性。这与城市更新中的时空数据挖掘、交通分析和出行行为建模高度相关。
papers.abstract: Path representation learning (PRL) for road networks has received increasing research attention, due to various path-related applications. Existing works on PRL typically exploit the co-occurrence relationship among road segments and paths to learn a vector as the path representation, without exploring the varied traveler behaviors and the regional correlation on the path. In this work, we propose to learn distributional representations, which provide valuable information for use in path-related applications, by capturing the varied traveler behaviors as well as the various dependencies within regions of road segments. We propose a novel Transformer-based Multi-view Distributional Representation Learning (TraveL) framework to encode a path along with a travel starting time to a distributional representation, which can be used to decode possible samples of on-path traveler behavior. Moreover, by analyzing the regional correlation which reveals various road segment relationships, we propose a regional attention to encode these correlations in a path. Also, we explore the idea of Kolmogorov-Smirnov (K-S) test to compare the sampled traveler behavior against the collected ground truth to facilitate training. Experimental results show that the proposed TraveL model outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on both synthetic and real-world datasets, by 14.7% in Mean K-S distance for travel time distribution estimation, 16.7% in Mean Absolute Error (MAE) for path similarity prediction, and 3.97% in MAE for destination prediction.
papers.summary_zh: 针对现有路径表示学习忽略出行者行为差异和区域相关性的问题，本文提出TraveL框架。该框架将路径和出行起始时间编码为分布表示，以捕捉路径上出行者行为的可能样本。通过分析区域相关性，提出区域注意力机制来编码路径中的道路段关系，并利用K-S检验来优化训练。实验表明TraveL在出行时间分布估计、路径相似性预测和目的地预测等任务上优于现有方法。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究通过分布表示而非单一向量来建模路径，能够更精细地刻画不同出行者的行为模式。在城市更新中，该方法可用于分析不同人群的出行需求，评估更新方案对交通流量和出行时间分布的影响。

papers.title: GeoNatureAgent Benchmark: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Environmental Geospatial Analysis Across Frontier and Open-Weight Foundation Models
papers.title_zh: GeoNatureAgent基准：评估前沿与开源基础模型上的环境地理空间分析LLM智能体
papers.reason: 该基准测试聚焦于评估LLM智能体在环境地理空间分析中的能力，直接关联博士研究中LLM和多智能体与地理空间智能的交叉方向。
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出了一个名为GeoNatureAgent的基准测试，用于评估不同LLM智能体在环境地理空间分析任务上的表现，涵盖了前沿和开源的基础模型。
papers.insight_zh: 构建针对地理空间分析的LLM智能体基准，是衡量和推动该领域模型能力发展的关键一步，有助于识别当前模型的局限和未来改进方向。

papers.title: Earth observation embeddings are effective sub-grid descriptors for probabilistic weather downscaling
papers.title_zh: 地球观测嵌入作为概率天气降尺度的有效子网格描述符
authors: Richard E. Turner (2) ((1) Department of Computer Science
papers.reason: 该论文直接利用地球观测嵌入进行概率天气降尺度，与遥感变化检测和多源数据融合高度相关。
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出使用地球观测嵌入作为子网格描述符，用于概率天气降尺度，以提高预测精度。
papers.insight_zh: 该方法可能为城市更新中的气候适应性和环境监测提供更精细的天气数据支持。

papers.title: Puffin-World: Scaling a Unified Multimodal Model with Native 3D World States
papers.title_zh: Puffin-World：扩展具有原生3D世界状态的统一多模态模型
papers.reason: 该研究提出一种统一的多模态架构，原生集成物理、几何和外观三种3D世界状态，实现物理一致的3D世界生成与重建。这与城市更新中构建城市数字孪生、模拟物理环境变化的需求高度契合，其联合建模和闭环探索的思想对发展具备物理常识的地理空间智能体具有重要启示。
papers.abstract: We propose Puffin-World, a unified multimodal architecture that integrates physical understanding, spatial simulation, and 3D world generation and reconstruction without relying on external offline modules. To reliably construct and interact with 3D worlds, our framework jointly models three native world states: physics (gravity field and latitude), geometry (depth), and appearance (image), together with a unified Omni-Camera representation that supports diverse tasks and flexible motions. Beyond modeling these states, we introduce a strategy for propagating physical dynamics across future frames. By grounding absolute camera properties in the real world, Puffin-World enables physically consistent and visually stable world generation. We further couple appearance and geometry within a single generative process, jointly synthesizing each future view and reconstructing its underlying geometry. This unified paradigm enables interleaved closed-loop applications requiring synergy across multiple tasks, including mimic and self-calibrated world exploration. To scale Puffin-World to complex scenarios, we construct Puffin-16M, comprising 15 million vision-language-camera triplets and 1 million trajectories featuring various and challenging motions. To foster further research in this area, we released the code, models, and datasets.
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出Puffin-World，一种统一的多模态架构，无需外部离线模块即可整合物理理解、空间模拟以及3D世界生成与重建。该框架联合建模三种原生世界状态：物理（重力场和纬度）、几何（深度）和外观（图像），并采用统一的Omni-Camera表示以支持多样任务和灵活运动。通过将绝对相机属性锚定在真实世界，Puffin-World能够实现物理一致且视觉稳定的世界生成。此外，作者将外观和几何耦合在单一生成过程中，联合合成未来视图并重建其底层几何。这种统一范式支持需要多任务协同的交错闭环应用，包括模仿和自我校准的世界探索。为扩展到复杂场景，作者构建了包含1500万视觉-语言-相机三元组和100万条轨迹的Puffin-16M数据集。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究提出将物理规律作为显式的世界状态与视觉外观联合建模，而非隐式学习，这为构建能够理解和模拟真实世界物理规律的多模态模型提供了新范式，对需要高保真物理一致性的城市级模拟和预测任务至关重要。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Novel Depth Synthesis Using 3D Foundation Models Scene Representations
papers.title_zh: 利用3D基础模型场景表示的零样本新视角深度合成
papers.reason: 论文利用3D基础模型的内部表示进行新视角深度合成，属于三维视觉与场景理解的前沿研究，与遥感变化检测和地理空间智能中的三维场景理解有较强关联。
papers.abstract: 3D Foundation Models (3DFMs) such as VGGT have recently pushed the boundaries of 3D vision by predicting rich unified representations with feed-foward transformers. The scene representations learned by these models enable strong performance on multiple 3D vision tasks. In this paper, we investigate using their internal representations to infer 3D in the scene from new views. Our hypothesis is that in order to solve the task of 3D reconstruction, these models need to learn a representation that includes a large amount of general knowledge about 3D scenes. After showing that it is possible to decode hidden surfaces from internal 3DFM representations, we propose a method, Z3D, that estimates pointmaps in unseen views by doing latent diffusion on 3DFM representation. We show that Z3D can predict realistic depth maps for new views across multiple datasets.
papers.summary_zh: 论文研究了如何利用3D基础模型（如VGGT）的内部表示来推断场景中新视角的3D信息。作者首先证明可以从内部3DFM表示中解码隐藏表面，然后提出方法Z3D，通过对3DFM表示进行潜在扩散来估计未见视角的点图。实验表明Z3D能在多个数据集上为新视角预测出逼真的深度图。
papers.insight_zh: 3D基础模型在解决三维重建任务时，其内部表示蕴含了关于3D场景的通用知识，这些知识可以被解码并用于新视角的深度推断，展示了基础模型作为场景表示引擎的潜力。

papers.title: Unlocking Lossless Speedups in LLMs via Discrete Diffusion
papers.title_zh: 通过离散扩散实现LLM的无损加速
papers.reason: 该论文提出一种结合自回归与扩散的LLM加速方法，与LLM和多智能体研究方向高度相关，对提升地理空间文本分析的效率有潜在价值。
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) owe much of their success to next-token prediction (NTP), but their autoregressive (AR) structure requires slow, sequential token generation. To overcome this bottleneck, we introduce diffusion-augmented LLMs, a new class of models that defines an AR model distribution while using diffusion to draw multiple tokens in parallel from that distribution. We decouple the parameters of these models into two sets: AR weights, trained using the standard NTP objective, and lightweight diffusion weights, trained to generate multiple tokens simultaneously. The diffusion weights are learned through a simple Diffusion Distillation phase that adds negligible overhead to existing LLM training pipelines. We also introduce $\Psi$-Spec, a family of samplers that enables lossless acceleration and inference-time scaling at a fixed context length. Unlike speculative decoding, our method requires no separate draft model. Unlike diffusion LLMs (d-LLMs), it accelerates generation without sacrificing the quality of the underlying AR model. The resulting models, called Uno, can be trained from scratch or built by augmenting existing open-weight AR LLMs. Uno achieves higher throughput than leading speculative-decoding methods at every evaluated batch size and delivers up to $3\times$ speedups over the base AR model, including at the largest batch size supported by the device. Notably, our 8B Uno model outperforms the leading open d-LLM, the 26B DiffusionGemma, and the proprietary Mercury 2 across all evaluated benchmarks in agentic tool use, coding, and long-context reasoning. We release code and checkpoints at: https://s-sahoo.github.io/uno/
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出扩散增强LLMs（Uno），通过轻量级扩散权重并行生成多个token，在不损失底层自回归模型质量的前提下实现加速。该方法无需单独的草稿模型，在多个基准上优于现有投机解码方法，最高可实现3倍加速。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究为LLM推理加速提供了新思路，可应用于大规模地理文本数据处理，提高时空数据挖掘的效率。

papers.title: Sparse auto-regressive modeling for scene generation from multi-view images
papers.title_zh: 基于稀疏自回归建模的多视角图像场景生成
papers.reason: 论文提出从稀疏多视角图像生成完整3D场景的稀疏自回归生成模型，与用户研究中三维场景理解、遥感变化检测和多源数据融合方向高度相关，其无需3D真值监督的稀疏潜在空间方法具有创新性。
papers.abstract: Generating complete 3D scenes from sparse, unconstrained views is a fundamental challenge in 3D vision which requires reasoning beyond observed content while remaining computationally tractable. Existing feed-forward reconstruction methods are inherently limited to content visible in the input images, while 3D generative modeling is hindered by the high computational cost of dense volumetric representations and the scarcity of large-scale 3D supervision. We introduce SPAR3S, a sparse voxel-aligned 3D latent generative model for conditional scene completion without requiring ground-truth 3D data for supervision. Our key insight is to formulate 3D scene generation in a structured, compact, voxel-aligned 3D latent space where only occupied voxels are represented. We learn this sparse latent space directly from multi-view images using photometric supervision via differentiable 3D Gaussian Splatting. Given a partial set of observed voxels encoded from sparse input views, scene completion reduces to predicting the missing latent tokens and their spatial support within the voxel grid. To this end, we train a masked autoregressive transformer that jointly models voxel occupancy and latent token values, enabling efficient and spatially consistent generation of unseen regions. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on synthetic indoor scenes, achieving higher novel-view quality than prior work. We further validate its generalization on RealEstate10k, highlighting its applicability to real-world data.
papers.summary_zh: 论文提出SPAR3S，一种稀疏体素对齐的3D潜在生成模型，用于条件场景补全，无需3D真值数据监督。该方法在仅表示占据体素的紧凑体素对齐潜在空间中，通过可微3D高斯泼溅的光度监督从多视角图像学习，并使用掩码自回归Transformer联合建模体素占用和潜在标记值，以生成未见区域。
papers.insight_zh: 将3D场景生成问题转化为稀疏体素潜在空间中的掩码自回归预测，可有效利用多视角图像进行无3D监督的场景补全，并在合成室内场景和真实世界数据上验证了其有效性。

papers.title: Concept of a Sensor Test Environment for Dusty Agricultural Conditions
papers.title_zh: 农业多尘条件下传感器测试环境的概念设计
papers.reason: 该论文提出针对农业多尘环境的传感器测试场概念，直接涉及传感器性能评估，与GIS中环境感知和传感器数据质量研究相关。
papers.abstract: Dust in agriculture presents a significant challenge for autonomous agricultural machinery. Dust can impair the performance of sensors and algorithms. This work, therefore, presents a concept for a proving ground consisting of an indoor and outdoor area. The indoor area comprises a laboratory test bench where dust circulates in a closed system and a test hall where life-size objects can be placed. The outdoor area features dedicated test setups that enable reproducible data to be recorded with and without dust during real-world agriculture work. The proving ground and the setups are visualized in 3D.
papers.summary_zh: 提出一个包含室内和室外区域的传感器测试场概念，室内有封闭循环灰尘的实验室测试台和可放置实物模型的测试厅，室外则用于真实农业作业中的可重复数据采集。
papers.insight_zh: 为评估灰尘对传感器和算法的影响，需要设计可控、可重复的室内外测试环境，以支持在真实农业条件下进行可靠的传感器性能验证。

papers.title: VI3: Grounding Pretrained 3D Foundation Models with Inertial Cues
papers.title_zh: VI3：利用惯性线索锚定预训练的3D基础模型
papers.reason: 论文解决3D基础模型在单目视觉下无法获取绝对尺度的问题，通过融合IMU数据进行度量锚定。这与多源数据融合（视觉+惯性）和地理空间智能高度相关，尤其对无人机、移动测量等需要精确地理定位的GIS应用有直接价值。
papers.abstract: 3D foundation models (3DFMs) excel at predicting camera poses and dense depth from multiple views of a scene, showcasing strong zero-shot generalization. However, as metric scale is not observable from monocular images, their absolute scale predictions are typically inaccurate. Inertial measurement units (IMUs), present in most devices, naturally complement monocular cameras by observing scaled motion. We introduce VI3, a model-agnostic framework that metrically anchors a pretrained 3DFM using only IMU readings. VI3 initializes and preintegrates the IMU to obtain a metric motion reference, which is then used to recover the scale of the 3DFM outputs. Our method includes adaptable anchoring strategies tailored to diverse 3DFM architectures. Experiments on synthetic and real aerial datasets demonstrate that VI3 recovers metric scale without ground-truth supervision while preserving geometric consistency, acting as a fine refinement under well-conditioned motion and as a strong prior when motion is less informative.
papers.summary_zh: 3D基础模型（3DFM）在从多视图预测相机位姿和稠密深度方面表现出色，但单目图像无法观测度量尺度，导致绝对尺度预测不准。本文提出VI3，一个模型无关的框架，仅利用IMU读数对预训练3DFM进行度量锚定。VI3初始化并对IMU进行预积分以获得度量运动参考，进而恢复3DFM输出的尺度。实验表明，VI3无需真值监督即可恢复度量尺度，同时保持几何一致性。
papers.insight_zh: 在缺乏绝对尺度信息的视觉任务中，低成本、普遍存在的IMU传感器可作为关键的度量先验。这种模型无关的“锚定”策略，为将通用视觉基础模型应用于需要精确地理配准的GIS任务（如三维重建、地图更新）提供了有效途径。

papers.title: CauseCollab: Causal Unified and Modality-Agnostic Network for Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception
papers.title_zh: CauseCollab：用于异构协同感知的因果统一且模态无关网络
papers.reason: 论文提出因果统一且模态无关的协同感知网络，解决异构传感器和模型架构下的语义不一致问题，与用户研究中多源数据融合和地理空间智能方向高度相关，其因果视角和统一转换器设计具有创新性。
papers.abstract: Collaborative perception enhances environment understanding through multi-agent information sharing, but its performance in real-world scenarios is constrained by heterogeneous sensor modalities and model architectures. Recent protocol-based two-stage methods alleviate this problem by mapping heterogeneous features into a shared protocol space; however, independently trained modality-specific converters often generate modality-specific pseudo-protocol distributions, leading to semantic inconsistency and error accumulation, which is particularly pronounced in scenarios with large modality discrepancies. To address this issue, we propose CauseCollab, a causal unified and modality-agnostic network. CauseCollab formulates representation learning in the protocol space from a causal perspective, explicitly disentangling semantic factors from modality-specific statistical confounders via causal metric learning. Meanwhile, CauseCollab adopts context-guided Unified Converter for heterogeneous modalities to ensure cross-modal semantic consistency. In addition, integrating new modalities only requires training adapters with minimal parameters. Extensive experiments on the OPV2V and DAIR-V2X datasets demonstrate that CauseCollab achieves state-of-the-art performance, with more significant gains in scenarios involving large modality gaps.
papers.summary_zh: 论文提出CauseCollab，一种因果统一且模态无关的协同感知网络。该方法从因果角度表述协议空间中的表示学习，通过因果度量学习显式解耦语义因素与模态特定的统计混淆因素，并采用上下文引导的统一转换器确保跨模态语义一致性。集成新模态仅需训练少量参数的适配器。
papers.insight_zh: 从因果视角解耦语义因素与模态特定混淆因素，并采用统一转换器，可有效解决异构协同感知中的语义不一致问题，在模态差异大的场景下性能提升更显著。

papers.title: From Nowcasting to Forecasting: Adapting a Reanalysis-Trained
papers.title_zh: 从临近预报到预报：适应再分析训练的云量预报模型
papers.reason: 研究基于观测初始条件的机器学习云量预报，与遥感变化检测和气象地理应用高度相关。
papers.abstract: Accurate cloud-cover forecasts are important for temperature prediction, radiation forecasting, and solar-power operations. Short-range forecasting methods can preserve observed cloud placement during the first forecast hours, but their skill decreases when cloud fields evolve through formation, dissipation and deformation. Longer lead times require accounting for atmospheric evolution, but operational numerical weather prediction (NWP) forecasts may not accurately represent the satellite-observed cloud state at initialization. We develop CloudCast v2, a machine-learning model for 12-hour cloud-cover forecasting from observation-based initial conditions. The model is first trained on the Copernicus European Regional Reanalysis (Ridal2024) to learn cloud-evolution dynamics, and is then adapted to satellite-derived cloud fields using conditional flow matching (Lipman2023), a generative method that transforms noise into cloud-cover forecasts conditioned on the observed initial cloud fields and NWP inputs. CloudCast v2 reduces mean absolute error by 10% relative to its predecessor, CloudCast v1 (Partio2025), over the 1-12 h range. It also overtakes CloudCast v1 in fractions skill score, a neighborhood-based measure of spatial agreement, after approximately 3-6 h, depending on the cloudiness category. These results show that observation-initialized machine-learning forecasts can extend beyond the usual 1-3-hour nowcasting range while retaining spatial detail from satellite cloud fields.
papers.summary_zh: 开发CloudCast v2，一种12小时云量预报模型。先在再分析数据上训练学习云演变动力学，再用条件流匹配适配到卫星观测云场。相比前身，平均绝对误差降低10%，在数小时后空间技能评分更优。
papers.insight_zh: 通过两阶段训练（先学习物理动态，再适配观测数据），可延长观测初始化的机器学习预报时效，同时保持空间细节。

papers.title: SimSkill: A Lifelong Learning AI Agent for Autonomous Mastery of Traffic Simulation
papers.title_zh: SimSkill：用于自主掌握交通模拟的终身学习AI智能体
papers.reason: 论文提出基于LLM的终身学习智能体SimSkill，用于自主掌握SUMO交通模拟技能。这与城市更新中的交通模拟、时空数据挖掘以及LLM和多智能体研究方向高度相关。
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly capable, the long-term value of AI systems depends not only on solving individual requests, but also on transforming experience and accumulated knowledge into durable, reusable competence. We introduce SimSkill, a self-evolving agent built around the Simulation of Urban MObility (SUMO) traffic simulator. SimSkill identifies capability gaps, generates and solves environment-grounded tasks, verifies solutions through an action--critic loop, and consolidates experience into episodic, procedural, and semantic memory without updating the backbone model. Through autonomous exploration, it builds a reusable library spanning the traffic-simulation workflow. We evaluate SimSkill on two held-out benchmarks with three backbone LLMs and independent artifact-based verification. SimSkill improves verified completion by up to 25 percentage points, while ablations show complementary contributions from procedural and semantic memory. Its benefits remain backbone- and budget-dependent: memory does not improve every model or uniformly reduce inference cost. More broadly, SimSkill illustrates a design paradigm in which natural language preserves and composes computational capabilities, while executable tools and code provide precise and reproducible execution. All code and experimental data are publicly available at https://github.com/qiliuchn/SimSkill-V1.
papers.summary_zh: SimSkill是一个基于SUMO交通模拟器的自进化智能体，通过识别能力差距、生成并解决环境任务、验证解决方案，并将经验整合到情景、程序和语义记忆中，无需更新骨干模型即可构建可复用的技能库。在多个基准测试中，SimSkill将验证完成率提升了高达25个百分点。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究展示了LLM智能体通过记忆机制实现技能积累的潜力，其效果依赖于骨干模型和计算预算，为城市交通模拟的自动化提供了新思路。

papers.title: MetaStructAtlas: A Grounded 3D Vision-Language Dataset and Benchmark for Functional and Structural Reasoning in Whole-Body PET/CT
papers.title_zh: MetaStructAtlas：用于全身PET/CT功能和结构推理的3D视觉语言数据集与基准
papers.reason: 该研究构建了全身PET/CT的3D视觉语言数据集和基准，涉及多模态融合与结构化推理，与多源数据融合和地理空间智能有方法论上的高度相似性，对医学影像分析有直接贡献。
papers.abstract: The joint interpretation of metabolic function and anatomical structure is essential for clinical diagnosis in whole-body PET/CT. Although recent advances in 3D medical vision-language models have demonstrated remarkable progress, current efforts are limited to regional CT imaging, leaving a critical void in comprehensive whole-body PET/CT analysis. In this work, we introduce MetaStructAtlas, a large-scale dataset for grounded whole-body PET/CT interpretation that synthesizes multimodal imaging with integrated anatomical, metabolic, and semantic annotations. MetaStructAtlas provides 490 co-registered 3D PET and CT volumes with 50,470 organ-level segmentation masks and grounded radiology reports. To facilitate interactive reasoning, we further developed MetaStructVQA, a standardized 3D grounded visual question-answering benchmark containing 100,565 QA pairs. This framework explicitly links diagnostic queries to visual evidence across modalities, encompassing anatomical, morphological, and metabolic characteristics. Finally, we evaluate state-of-the-art 3D medical VLMs on MetaStructVQA, establishing a robust foundation for multimodal representation learning and integrated whole-body reasoning in nuclear medicine.
papers.summary_zh: 本文介绍MetaStructAtlas，一个大规模全身PET/CT解释数据集，包含490对配准的3D PET和CT影像、50,470个器官级分割掩膜和接地报告。同时开发了MetaStructVQA基准，含100,565个问答对，将诊断查询与跨模态视觉证据关联。研究评估了现有3D医学视觉语言模型，为核医学中的多模态表示学习和全身推理奠定基础。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作通过构建包含解剖、代谢和语义注释的多模态数据集，推动了3D医学影像的联合推理，其数据集构建和基准评估方法对遥感领域多模态数据融合研究具有参考价值。

papers.title: Understanding Autonomous Driving Datasets by Describing Differences between Image Subsets in Natural Language
papers.title_zh: 通过自然语言描述图像子集差异来理解自动驾驶数据集
papers.reason: 论文研究自动驾驶图像数据集的子集差异描述，涉及图像理解与自然语言生成，与GIS中遥感影像场景理解、数据质量分析有较强的方法论关联。
papers.abstract: Understanding the composition of large-scale autonomous driving datasets is essential for safety, robustness, and reliable operation across domains. For example, domain shift between locations could lead to the operating environment being misaligned with the training data, resulting in potentially dangerous performance degradation. Yet, existing data analysis pipelines largely rely on metadata, predefined labels, or manual inspection, which provide limited semantic insight or do not scale. This paper studies set difference captioning: given two subsets of images, the goal is to produce a natural-language hypothesis describing differences between the target and reference set. Building on a two-stage formulation, we adapt the method to autonomous driving by focusing on object-centric patches derived from object detection, which simplifies aggregation and enables attribution of differences to specific object instances or categories. To evaluate this setting in-domain, we introduce a new benchmark, AD-Diff Bench. Low-concentration experiments assess the suitability of set-difference-captioning approaches to sparse, real-world differences. We restrict our experiments to open-weight models to support reproducibility and ease of deployment. The proposed benchmark and analysis provide a step towards practical, human-interpretable dataset introspection for autonomous driving datasets. Our implementation and benchmark dataset are available at https://github.com/KIT-MRT/AD-Diff
papers.summary_zh: 研究集合差异描述任务，即给定两个图像子集，生成描述目标集与参考集差异的自然语言假设。提出基于两阶段公式的方法，并引入新基准AD-Diff Bench。
papers.insight_zh: 该方法可启发GIS领域对遥感影像数据集进行自动化的语义差异分析，例如比较不同时期或不同区域的影像特征，辅助理解地理变化。

papers.title: KhatianDoc: A Human-Verified Benchmark Diagnosing Multimodal LLM Failure on Bengali Legal Land Records
papers.title_zh: KhatianDoc：一个经人工验证的基准，用于诊断多模态LLM在孟加拉语法律土地记录上的失败
papers.reason: 该研究构建了针对孟加拉语法律土地记录的基准测试，评估多模态LLM在符号识别、结构化提取和文档问答上的能力。其涉及复杂文档解析、多模态理解和基准构建，与GIS中处理非结构化地理空间文本数据（如地籍记录）有较强关联，对评估和提升模型在特定领域文档上的能力有参考价值。
papers.abstract: Land ownership in Bangladesh is recorded in Ana-Ganda-Kora-Kranti-Til, a base-16 positional fraction system with dedicated Unicode glyphs, no mainstream font, and no coverage in any OCR pipeline or tokenizer. The handwritten records that carry these fractions, RS Khatians, are the authoritative title record for millions of parcels and a frequent subject of civil litigation, yet no benchmark has asked whether a machine can read one. We introduce KhatianDoc, a four-task benchmark built from 107 real RS Khatian records from the Vumi (land) Office of Munshiganj, Bangladesh: symbol recognition, base-16-to-decimal conversion, structured field extraction, and legal document question answering over 1,634 QA pairs. Ground truth was transcribed by hand, verified by a land-law practitioner to full agreement, and anonymized through positional tokens that keep the referential distinctions multi-hop questions depend on. We evaluate six multimodal LLMs (8B to 72B+, open and closed) under a fixed zero-shot protocol. Five QA categories, 39.3% of our stratified set, return zero correct answers from every model; on the arithmetic task, every model that emits a number does worse than a constant-mean baseline, with exact- and near-match scores coinciding: decorrelation, not approximation. Auditing our own metrics surfaced two artifacts in opposite directions: we correct a refusal-scoring bug and report the fixed scores beside the originals, and flag an inflated metadata metric as an upper bound. KhatianDoc documents not a performance gap but the absence of a capability, with verified ground truth for future systems. Code and data, with a redacted image release, are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh: 孟加拉国的土地所有权记录在一种基数为16的分数系统中，该系统具有专用Unicode字形，但无主流字体支持，也无OCR或分词器覆盖。本文介绍KhatianDoc，一个基于107份真实RS Khatian记录构建的四任务基准：符号识别、基数16到十进制转换、结构化字段提取和法律文档问答（含1634个问答对）。真实标签由人工转录并经土地法律从业者验证。评估了六种多模态LLM（8B至72B+），发现五个问答类别中39.3%的样本所有模型均回答错误；在算术任务上，所有模型表现均不如常数均值基线。该基准记录了能力的缺失，而非性能差距。
papers.insight_zh: 针对高度专业化和低资源语言的文档，现有通用多模态LLM可能完全缺乏处理能力，构建人工验证的领域特定基准是诊断和推动模型能力发展的关键。

papers.title: Drive-HWM: Hierarchical World Models for Dynamic-Latent Guided Autonomous Driving
papers.title_zh: Drive-HWM：用于动态潜在引导自动驾驶的层次化世界模型
papers.reason: 论文提出层次化世界模型用于自动驾驶场景预测和决策，其慢-快框架、动态感知潜在表征和未来表征预测等思想，对地理空间智能中的动态场景理解、时空数据挖掘和预测建模具有直接借鉴意义。
papers.abstract: World models offer a promising paradigm for autonomous driving by predicting how traffic scenes may evolve and using such predictions to support action generation. However, existing approaches either separate future prediction from action generation or jointly predict them at the same temporal scale, making it difficult to simultaneously achieve long-horizon anticipation and responsive, observation-grounded decision making. We present Drive-HWM, a hierarchical slow--fast world modeling framework that organizes future representation prediction and action generation at complementary temporal scales. The slow world model predicts multi-step future representations to capture extended scene evolution. To explicitly model the abundant motion dynamics in driving environments, we introduce Dynamic-Aware Latents learned through optical-flow prediction. Guided by these future representations, the fast model uses a lightweight multimodal backbone and an autoregressive expert to jointly predict the next frame and the immediate action from the latest observation. Next-frame prediction encourages the fast model to capture imminent scene evolution, while one-step action generation allows decisions to be continuously updated as new observations arrive. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM v1 and v2 demonstrate the strong driving performance of Drive-HWM. Comprehensive ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of the hierarchical slow--fast design, dynamics-aware future representations, and joint next-frame and action prediction.
papers.summary_zh: 论文提出Drive-HWM，一个慢-快层次化世界建模框架，用于自动驾驶。慢模型预测多步未来表征以捕捉长期场景演变，并引入通过光流预测学习的动态感知潜在表征。快模型则利用轻量级多模态主干和自回归专家，从最新观测联合预测下一帧和即时动作。在NAVSIM v1和v2上的实验证明了其强大性能。
papers.insight_zh: 将场景演变预测与动作生成解耦到不同时间尺度，并显式建模动态信息，是提升智能体在复杂动态环境中决策能力的一种有效范式。

papers.title: GPS-Bench: A Governance Policy Benchmark for Automating Policy Analysis
papers.title_zh: GPS-Bench：用于自动化政策分析的治理政策基准
papers.reason: 论文提出了一个基于证据的治理政策模拟基准，用于评估LLM和多智能体在政策分析中的表现。这与城市更新中涉及的政策分析、利益相关者模拟和影响评估高度相关。
papers.abstract: Policy analysis requires more than predicting whether a proposal will pass: it requires identifying who will be affected, how those actors respond, and what follows. LLM-based policy simulations model these processes at scale, but their validity is hard to establish when plausible behaviour is never compared with observed outcomes. We introduce GPS-Bench, an evidence-grounded benchmark for governance policy simulation that links policies to relevant actors, actor actions and downstream impacts using legislative records, lobbying disclosures, regulatory documents, corporate filings, economic data and other public evidence. Actors are reconstructed from the dated record rather than prompted as archetypes, so a persona is an evidence object with provenance; a human-annotated pool forms the Gold evaluation set, while cases labelled by a separate LLM from retrieved evidence are treated as Silver supervision and never as test labels. Because every inference mode reads the same grounded state and emits the same schema, GPS-Bench turns "does multi-agent simulation help?" into a controlled comparison: we contrast joint reasoning, independent and communicating actor agents, graph-based methods and weight-level fine-tuning over one policy state. Fine-tuning on the grounded record gives the strongest actor-level impact prediction, and decomposition does not beat it; what decomposition adds is mechanism. Agents hold private, non-identical evidence, each seeing its own exposure clause, and address named partners with concrete joint proposals, what they offer, what they need in return, and why acting together beats acting alone, so the coalitions that form can be checked against the commitments the record holds. GPS-Bench therefore gives a common empirical setting for studying when evidence, actor modelling and multi-agent interaction improve the prediction and interpretation of policy outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 政策分析需要识别受影响者、其反应及后续影响。GPS-Bench是一个基于证据的治理政策模拟基准，将政策与相关行动者、行动及下游影响联系起来，利用立法记录、游说披露等公共证据构建行动者模型。该基准支持对比联合推理、独立/通信智能体、图方法和微调等不同模式，以研究多智能体模拟的有效性。
papers.insight_zh: 该基准强调基于证据的行动者建模和可验证的模拟结果，为城市更新政策模拟提供了方法论框架，即通过真实数据构建利益相关者模型，并评估不同模拟策略的预测能力。
